note: Prototype: entries are marked confirmed after the author's review. In production Karandeep confirms each entry before it is used.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India; services to hotels, airlines, non-OTA businesses and non-travel-booking work are carved out.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the term plus 12 months after expiry or termination; depends on the term (scheduled expiry 30 June 2024, so tail to 30 June 2025 unless terminated earlier or extended by mutual written agreement)
entries.quoted_clause: the Service Provider agrees that during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its expiry or termination, it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
entries.why_it_matters: It blocked AtliQ from pursuing any Indian OTA prospect until at least mid-2025 (longer if extended), so the actual term end must be confirmed; the post-term tail may also be unenforceable under s.27 of the Indian Contract Act.

entries.scope: Mutual ban on soliciting the other party's employees.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the term and six months thereafter; depends on the term (scheduled expiry 30 June 2024, so to 31 December 2024 unless terminated earlier or extended)
entries.quoted_clause: Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other during the term and six months thereafter.
entries.why_it_matters: It restricted AtliQ from recruiting Orbit Travels staff until six months after the agreement ends, which matters for any hiring from this client.

entries.scope: Client-specific deliverables vest in Orbit Travels on full payment, while AtliQ retains its pre-existing tools and know-how.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual (ownership transfers on full payment)
entries.quoted_clause: All deliverables developed specifically for the Client shall be the property of the Client upon full payment. The Service Provider retains its pre-existing tools and know-how.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse the booking engine, fare search or reporting code built for Orbit with other clients, but may reuse its pre-existing tools and know-how.

entries.scope: AtliQ Inc. warrants its rates and commercial terms to Crestline will be no less favourable than those AtliQ or any Affiliate offers any other customer for substantially similar services, with retroactive credits and an audit right.
entries.region: Global (applies to any customer of Supplier or its Affiliates); contract governed by Ohio law
entries.sector: Data engineering, business intelligence and analytics services
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term (until July 31, 2027, unless earlier terminated)
entries.quoted_clause: Supplier represents and warrants that the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term.
entries.why_it_matters: Any lower rate quoted by any AtliQ entity to any client for similar data/BI work triggers notice duties, retroactive repricing and credits to Crestline, auditable annually, so group-wide pricing must be checked against the Exhibit B rate card.

entries.scope: AtliQ Inc. and its personnel, including approved subcontractors, may not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without prior written approval and must follow Crestline's Vendor Data Security Requirements as updated.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term (until July 31, 2027) and any Work Orders continuing after expiry
entries.quoted_clause: Supplier shall not access Crestline production data from outside the United States without Crestline's prior written approval.
entries.why_it_matters: Restricts use of offshore delivery teams or affiliates and must be flowed down to any subcontractor, together with unilaterally updatable security requirements and 72-hour breach notice.

entries.scope: Crestline owns all Deliverables upon payment, while AtliQ Inc. retains its pre-existing materials, tools and know-how subject to a perpetual, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to Crestline where incorporated.
entries.sector: Data engineering, business intelligence and analytics services
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual
entries.quoted_clause: Upon payment, Crestline shall own all right, title and interest in the Deliverables. Supplier retains all rights in its pre-existing materials, tools and know-how ("Supplier Materials").
entries.why_it_matters: Work product built for Crestline cannot be reused for other clients, so reusable accelerators must be kept identifiable as Supplier Materials and any freelancer IP must be assigned to AtliQ to make this assignment effective.

entries.scope: AtliQ Inc.'s liability is uncapped (and consequential damages not excluded) for confidentiality breaches and its indemnities, including IP infringement and personnel employment-status claims.
entries.sector: Data engineering, business intelligence and analytics services
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term (until July 31, 2027); confidentiality survives three years post-termination
entries.quoted_clause: EXCEPT FOR BREACH OF SECTION 7 OR A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CRESTLINE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM.
entries.why_it_matters: Uncapped exposure for IP infringement, misclassification and confidentiality claims is a precedent clients may cite to resist AtliQ's normal 1x-fees cap.

entries.scope: All IP in Deliverables developed specifically for PayTrack (transaction analytics platform and ML anomaly detection module) vests in PayTrack on full payment, while AtliQ keeps its pre-existing materials, tools and know-how under a perpetual non-exclusive royalty-free licence to PayTrack.
entries.sector: Fintech / payments reconciliation and merchant settlement
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual (vests upon full payment; licence to pre-existing materials is perpetual)
entries.quoted_clause: Upon full payment, all intellectual property in the Deliverables developed specifically for PayTrack shall vest in PayTrack. AtliQ retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools and know-how and grants PayTrack a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use such materials as incorporated in the Deliverables.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse the PayTrack-specific anomaly detection models or code for other payments clients, so reusable components must be kept separately documented as pre-existing know-how.

entries.scope: Mutual ban on soliciting for employment the other Party's employees engaged in the Services.
entries.sector: Fintech / payments reconciliation and merchant settlement
entries.expiry_or_term: During the term (two years from 22 January 2025 unless terminated earlier) and for twelve (12) months thereafter
entries.quoted_clause: Neither Party shall solicit for employment the other Party's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ recruiters must not approach PayTrack staff who worked on the engagement until 12 months after the agreement ends, potentially into early 2028.

entries.scope: Client Data that is payment system data must be stored only in India under RBI data localisation requirements, with obligations on Client Data surviving indefinitely.
entries.sector: Fintech / payments reconciliation and merchant settlement
entries.expiry_or_term: Indefinite in respect of Client Data (survives termination)
entries.quoted_clause: AtliQ acknowledges that Client Data may include payment system data subject to RBI data localisation requirements, and shall ensure that such data is stored only in India.
entries.why_it_matters: Any subcontractor, freelancer or cloud/tooling vendor touching PayTrack data must be bound to India-only storage, which limits offshore resourcing and infrastructure choices.

entries.scope: AtliQ must process personal data only on PayTrack's instructions under DPDP Act, IT Act and RBI directions, report breaches within 24 hours, and allow PayTrack and its regulators to audit, and must comply with RBI IT outsourcing guidelines.
entries.sector: Fintech / payments reconciliation and merchant settlement
entries.expiry_or_term: Tied to the term (two years from 22 January 2025 unless terminated earlier), with Client Data obligations surviving
entries.quoted_clause: AtliQ shall notify PayTrack of any data breach within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of it, and shall cooperate with PayTrack in any reporting to CERT-In or the RBI. AtliQ shall permit PayTrack and its regulators to audit its compliance with this Clause 12 on reasonable notice.
entries.why_it_matters: The 24-hour breach notice and RBI/regulator audit rights must be flowed down to any subcontractor on this work and set a precedent for other regulated fintech clients.

entries.scope: All IP in Deliverables created specifically for Acme vests in Acme on full payment, while AtliQ keeps its pre-existing IP, tools, templates and know-how, licensed to Acme non-exclusively, perpetually and royalty-free for internal use.
entries.start_date: On receipt of full payment under the relevant SOW (Agreement effective 10 March 2025)
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual (assignment permanent; pre-existing IP licence perpetual)
entries.quoted_clause: Upon receipt of full payment, all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables created specifically for the Client shall vest in the Client.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse Acme-specific dashboards and data models for other retail clients, so the line between bespoke Deliverables and reusable pre-existing templates must be tracked.

entries.scope: Mutual ban on soliciting the other party's employees who were involved in the Services.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the term (two years from 10 March 2025, unless terminated earlier) plus six (6) months thereafter; depends on the term
entries.quoted_clause: During the term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit any employee of the other Party who was involved in the Services.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ must not recruit Acme's BI staff who worked on the project, for example Priya Raman's team, until six months after the Agreement ends.

entries.scope: Acme personal data may be processed only for the Services, in compliance with the DPDP Act 2023 and its rules, and with reasonable security practices.
entries.expiry_or_term: For as long as AtliQ processes Client personal data under the Agreement (term of two years unless terminated earlier)
entries.quoted_clause: The Service Provider shall process personal data received from the Client only for the purpose of the Services and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the rules made thereunder, as and when in force, and shall implement reasonable security practices.
entries.why_it_matters: Any freelancer or subcontractor handling Acme's POS or ERP personal data must be contractually bound to the same purpose limitation and DPDP-compliant security.

entries.scope: Neither AtliQ nor any of its Affiliates may provide data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business (including distribution, revenue-management and guest-analytics providers) headquartered in, or with properties or operations in, the GCC, wherever the work is performed, unless the Client gives written waiver (cl. 12.4).
entries.region: GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), wherever services are performed
entries.sector: Hospitality (hotels, resorts, serviced apartments and their distribution, revenue-management and guest-analytics providers)
entries.expiry_or_term: Term plus 18 months after expiry or termination (Restricted Period); if the Agreement runs its full term to 14 March 2028, the restriction ends around 14 September 2029, earlier if terminated early
entries.quoted_clause: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
entries.why_it_matters: This sector-wide, group-wide GCC ban blocks any analytics or AI work for other hotel groups or hospitality tech vendors in the region unless Al Noor signs a specific written waiver.

entries.scope: Mutual ban on soliciting for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services; general untargeted advertisements are permitted.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term plus 12 months after expiry or termination (to around 14 March 2029 if full term)
entries.quoted_clause: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services, save through general advertisements not targeted at such employees.
entries.why_it_matters: It limits AtliQ's recruiting of Al Noor staff who worked on the project, including for other hospitality engagements.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not subcontract any part of the Services, including to freelancers, without Al Noor's prior written consent, and it remains liable for its subcontractors.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the Term (to 14 March 2028 unless terminated earlier)
entries.quoted_clause: The Supplier shall not subcontract any part of the Services without the Client's prior written consent. The Supplier remains responsible for the acts and omissions of its subcontractors.
entries.why_it_matters: Any freelancer or vendor staffing on this account needs written client approval first.

entries.scope: Guest Data may not leave the UAE without written consent, and access from India must be remote into UAE-hosted environments only, with breach notice within 48 hours; these terms must flow down to any approved subcontractor.
entries.expiry_or_term: Survives expiry or termination (cl. 6.5); no end date stated
entries.quoted_clause: The Supplier shall not transfer Guest Data outside the UAE without the Client's prior written consent. Any Guest Data accessed from India shall be accessed remotely from UAE-hosted environments only.
entries.why_it_matters: It requires UAE-hosted infrastructure, controls on access from India, and flow-down to any subcontractor, which affects delivery models and tooling.

entries.scope: AtliQ's liability for breach of confidentiality, which covers Client Data and Guest Data, is excluded from the 12-month-fees cap and is therefore uncapped.
entries.expiry_or_term: Survives expiry or termination (cl. 6.5); confidentiality obligations run for 5 years after expiry or termination
entries.quoted_clause: Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 8 (Confidentiality), or death or personal injury caused by negligence.
entries.why_it_matters: Accepting uncapped exposure for confidentiality and data breaches departs from AtliQ's normal 1x-fees cap and is a precedent other clients may cite.

entries.scope: IP in bespoke Deliverables vests in Al Noor on payment, while AtliQ keeps its Background IP and grants Al Noor a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to any of it incorporated in Deliverables.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual
entries.quoted_clause: Upon payment in full of the relevant Fees, all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables created specifically for the Client shall vest in the Client.
entries.why_it_matters: Bespoke guest segmentation models and dashboards built for Al Noor cannot be reused for other clients, and only Background IP stays reusable.

entries.scope: Sunrise owns all IP in Deliverables built specifically for it under any SOW once paid, while AtliQ keeps its pre-existing tools, components, libraries and know-how and gives Sunrise a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to them.
entries.expiry_or_term: Ownership transfers on payment in full and is permanent; the licence of pre-existing materials is perpetual
entries.quoted_clause: Upon payment in full, Sunrise shall own all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables developed specifically for Sunrise under an SOW. AtliQ retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, components, libraries and know-how.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse Sunrise-specific distributor-portal code for other FMCG or distribution clients, so reusable components must be kept separate and documented as pre-existing.

entries.scope: Mutual ban on soliciting the other Party's employees who work on the Services.
entries.expiry_or_term: Depends on SOW term: runs for the term of each relevant SOW plus six (6) months thereafter (SOW-1 includes 12 months' post-go-live support)
entries.quoted_clause: Neither Party shall solicit the employees of the other Party engaged in the Services during the term of the relevant SOW and six (6) months thereafter.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ may not recruit Sunrise staff involved in the project until six months after each SOW ends, and new SOWs extend the restriction.

entries.scope: The Contractor retains ownership of all Work Product (dashboards, data models, DAX, Power Query scripts, templates, documentation) created for AtliQ and grants AtliQ only a non-exclusive licence.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual and irrevocable licence; Clause 5 survives termination or expiry
entries.quoted_clause: The Contractor retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product and in any pre-existing materials, components and templates of the Contractor. The Contractor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, worldwide licence to use, copy, modify and deploy the Work Product for the purposes of AtliQ's business, including for delivery to AtliQ's clients.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot assign ownership or grant exclusivity in this Work Product to Acme Retail Group or any other client, and the freelancer may reuse it for others under Clause 4.2, so it may breach any client SOW that requires IP assignment.

entries.scope: The Contractor must follow AtliQ clients' confidentiality and data-security requirements only once they have been notified to him in writing, including bans on downloading client data to personal devices.
entries.expiry_or_term: Survives for three (3) years after termination or expiry of the 12-month term (to 27 April 2026 unless extended)
entries.quoted_clause: The Contractor shall comply with any confidentiality and data-security requirements of AtliQ's clients notified to him in writing, including restrictions on downloading client data to personal devices.
entries.why_it_matters: The flow-down of client data obligations applies only if AtliQ has given written notice, so AtliQ must confirm that Acme's SOW data-security terms were actually notified in order to meet its own client obligations.

entries.scope: The Contractor may not directly solicit AtliQ clients he was introduced to through AtliQ to provide the same Services independently of AtliQ.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter (depends on term end; nominally until 27 October 2026)
entries.quoted_clause: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, the Contractor shall not directly solicit any AtliQ client to whom he was introduced through AtliQ for the purpose of providing the same Services to that client independently of AtliQ.
entries.why_it_matters: Client protection is narrow: it covers only direct solicitation of the same Services for six months and does not prevent the freelancer from accepting work from Acme or using his retained IP for it.

entries.scope: All IP in Deliverables, expressly including pre-existing tools, frameworks and libraries incorporated into them, which under SOW-1 includes AtliQ's proprietary PipeKit accelerator, vests in Northwind on payment of each Milestone.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual once assigned (on payment of each Milestone Fee); clause 9 survives termination
entries.quoted_clause: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.
entries.clause_ref: Clause 9.2 (read with Schedule 1, S1.2 and S1.3(b))
entries.why_it_matters: With no background-IP carve-out or licence-back, AtliQ may lose ownership of PipeKit and be unable to reuse it for other clients, so this needs urgent review or a corrective variation.

entries.scope: Mutual prohibition on soliciting the other party's employees engaged in the Services.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the term (3 years from 20 June 2025, unless terminated earlier) and for six (6) months afterwards
entries.quoted_clause: Neither party shall, during the term and for six (6) months afterwards, solicit any employee of the other party engaged in the Services.
entries.why_it_matters: It restricts AtliQ from recruiting Northwind staff who worked on the project, for example Tom Beckett's operations team, until six months after the agreement ends.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not subcontract or assign any rights or obligations without Northwind's prior written consent.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Agreement (3 years from 20 June 2025, unless terminated earlier)
entries.quoted_clause: The Supplier shall not assign or subcontract any of its rights or obligations without the Client's prior written consent.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot use freelancers or partner firms on Northwind work without written consent, and under clause 8.1 it remains responsible for any approved subcontractors.

entries.scope: Personal data must be processed only on Northwind's instructions under UK GDPR and the Schedule 3 processing terms, and any transfer to India must use the UK IDTA Addendum to the EU SCCs.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Agreement and survives termination (clause 6.5)
entries.quoted_clause: Any transfer of personal data to India shall be made subject to the UK International Data Transfer Addendum to the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
entries.why_it_matters: Any approved subcontractor handling Northwind data, for example telematics and driver data, must be bound by equivalent UK GDPR and IDTA terms, and Schedule 3 is not in the extracted copy, so it should be retrieved.

entries.scope: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not act as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Fabric-type offerings) in India or the GCC.
entries.region: India and GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman); services outside these countries are unrestricted
entries.sector: Cloud data-warehouse / lakehouse / unified analytics platforms
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term, until 31 August 2028 unless renewed; ceases when termination takes effect (either party may terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice)
entries.quoted_clause: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC. … "Competing Platform" means any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service.
entries.why_it_matters: Any AtliQ group entity, including a non-Indian affiliate, must check before taking a partner appointment, referral fee or benefit from a competing data platform provider for India/GCC work, though delivering on a customer-selected platform without a partner relationship is permitted under 7.3(b).

entries.scope: AtliQ may not actively solicit for employment CloudSpan employees with whom it had material contact under the Agreement, general advertisements excepted.
entries.expiry_or_term: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter (depends on the Term; latest 28 February 2029 if not renewed)
entries.quoted_clause: During the Term and for six (6) months thereafter, neither Party shall actively solicit for employment any employee of the other Party with whom it had material contact under this Agreement. General advertisements are not solicitation.
entries.why_it_matters: Restricts AtliQ's hiring of CloudSpan staff for the life of the partnership plus a tail period.

entries.scope: AtliQ accepted a liability cap with a USD 100,000 floor regardless of fees received, and uncapped liability for its IP indemnity and confidentiality breaches.
entries.expiry_or_term: Survives termination or expiry (Clause 14.4(d))
entries.quoted_clause: Each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement in any contract year shall not exceed the greater of (a) the total Referral Fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve (12) months and (b) USD 100,000. … Clauses 13.1 and 13.2 do not apply to liability under Clause 12, breach of Clause 9, or liability that cannot be limited by law.
entries.why_it_matters: The USD 100,000 floor can exceed AtliQ's normal 1x-fees cap, and the uncapped IP indemnity for AtliQ's own materials is a precedent other partners or clients may cite.

entries.scope: CloudSpan may use any AtliQ feedback on the CloudSpan Platform without restriction, while AtliQ retains its methodologies, accelerators, tools, templates and know-how.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual; survives termination or expiry (Clause 14.4(d))
entries.quoted_clause: Any feedback provided by Partner concerning the CloudSpan Platform may be used by CloudSpan without restriction, provided Partner's Confidential Information is not disclosed.
entries.why_it_matters: Ideas AtliQ shares as feedback become freely usable by CloudSpan, so accelerator or product concepts should be shared carefully to preserve the IP AtliQ retains under 8.2.

entries.scope: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd may not engage any further subcontractor, including freelancers or vendors, for the CareBridge patient-scheduling analytics services.
entries.region: USA (Covered Entity in Arizona); services performed from India
entries.counterparty: AtliQ Inc (Business Associate), flowing down from CareBridge Clinics, Inc. Upstream BAA No. CBC-BAA-2025-014
entries.expiry_or_term: Until the Upstream BAA expires or is terminated, or the Engagement Services end, whichever is earlier (Section 7.1)
entries.quoted_clause: Subcontractor shall not engage any further subcontractor for the Engagement Services.
entries.why_it_matters: All CareBridge work must be staffed with AtliQ Technologies' own personnel, so freelancers or third-party vendors cannot be used on this engagement.

entries.scope: AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd may access only De-identified Data, never PHI, and only inside the Covered Entity Environment or another approved secure environment, with no download, copying, re-identification or linking.
entries.region: USA (Covered Entity in Arizona); services performed from India
entries.counterparty: AtliQ Inc (Business Associate), for the benefit of CareBridge Clinics, Inc.
entries.expiry_or_term: Until the Upstream BAA expires or is terminated, or the Engagement Services end, whichever is earlier; on termination, written confirmation that no copies are held (Sections 7.1, 7.3)
entries.quoted_clause: Subcontractor and its personnel shall access De-identified Data only. Subcontractor shall not access, receive, store, view or process PHI.
entries.why_it_matters: Breach of Section 3 allows immediate termination of the engagement, and these limits constrain tooling, environments and any reuse of CareBridge data in other work.

entries.scope: Every restriction, condition and requirement in the CareBridge Upstream BAA that binds AtliQ Inc also binds AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd for the Engagement Services, including HHS Secretary access to its records.
entries.region: USA (Covered Entity in Arizona); services performed from India
entries.counterparty: AtliQ Inc (Business Associate), flowing down from CareBridge Clinics, Inc. Upstream BAA No. CBC-BAA-2025-014
entries.expiry_or_term: Until the Upstream BAA expires or is terminated, or the Engagement Services end, whichever is earlier (Section 7.1)
entries.quoted_clause: The restrictions, conditions and requirements of the Upstream BAA that apply to Business Associate apply equally to Subcontractor in performing the Engagement Services.
entries.why_it_matters: The Indian entity takes on Upstream BAA obligations whose terms are not set out in this Agreement, so the Upstream BAA must be checked for further restrictions.

entries.scope: PHI may only be accessed, stored and processed inside CareBridge's US-hosted environment by named US-located AtliQ personnel, and offshore personnel (including subcontractors) may touch De-identified Data only.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Master Services Agreement; survives for any PHI retained after termination (Sections 10.3-10.4)
entries.quoted_clause: Business Associate shall access, store and process PHI only within the Covered Entity Environment, and only through personnel of Business Associate who are located in the United States and who have been identified to Covered Entity by name in writing. No PHI shall be accessed, stored or processed outside the United States.
entries.why_it_matters: It stops AtliQ from staffing PHI work through any offshore team or affiliate, so delivery models for this and similar healthcare deals must be US-only for PHI.

entries.scope: Any subcontractor handling PHI must sign a written BAA with the same restrictions as AtliQ, expressly including the US-only access rule, and CareBridge must be notified in writing of every subcontractor engaged.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Master Services Agreement; return/destruction duties extend to subcontractors on termination
entries.quoted_clause: Business Associate shall ensure, in accordance with 45 C.F.R. §§ 164.502(e)(1)(ii) and 164.308(b)(2), that any Subcontractor that creates, receives, maintains or transmits PHI on behalf of Business Associate agrees in a written business associate agreement to the same restrictions, conditions and requirements that apply to Business Associate under this BAA, including Section 3.
entries.why_it_matters: Every freelancer, vendor or affiliate AtliQ uses on this work must accept a flowed-down BAA with the US-only restriction, and AtliQ stays responsible for their performance.

entries.scope: De-identified data derived from CareBridge PHI may be used only for CareBridge's Services and not for any other client, product or purpose.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Master Services Agreement (no express survival for de-identified data stated)
entries.quoted_clause: Business Associate may de-identify PHI in accordance with 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(b) solely for the purpose of performing the Services. De-identified Data may be used only for the Services and not for any other client, product or purpose.
entries.why_it_matters: It bars AtliQ from reusing CareBridge-derived datasets, benchmarks or trained models for other healthcare clients or its own products.

entries.scope: AtliQ accepted an aggregate liability cap for Breach or BAA-violation claims of 2x the fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months, plus reimbursement of notification and credit-monitoring costs.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Master Services Agreement and for claims arising during it
entries.quoted_clause: aggregate liability for claims relating to a Breach or a violation of this BAA shall not exceed two (2) times the Fees paid or payable under the Master Services Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
entries.why_it_matters: A 2x data-breach super-cap is above AtliQ's normal 1x fees position and may be cited as precedent by other healthcare clients.

entries.scope: Uncapped liquidated damages of 1% of the Contract Value (USD 920) per day or part day for each missed Key Date, payable on top of all other remedies and deductible from sums due.
entries.region: United States (Connecticut customer); English law, London courts
entries.expiry_or_term: Applies to Key Dates from 16 January 2026 to 29 May 2026; exposure continues for the 18-month term
entries.quoted_clause: If the Supplier fails to achieve any Key Date, the Supplier shall pay to the Customer liquidated damages in the amount of one per cent (1%) of the Contract Value for each day or part day by which the relevant Key Date is missed.
entries.why_it_matters: LDs have no ceiling, are excluded from the liability cap, and time is of the essence, so a 100-day slip would equal the full fee; this is a harmful precedent for Brightwater Group renewals and other insurer clients.

entries.scope: Supplier's general liability is capped at 150% of the Contract Value, while LDs and indemnities for confidentiality, data protection, IP infringement and negligence are left uncapped and extend to every Brightwater Group member.
entries.region: United States (Connecticut customer); English law, London courts
entries.counterparty: Brightwater Insurance Inc. and each member of the Brightwater Group
entries.expiry_or_term: For the 18-month term and surviving claims thereafter
entries.quoted_clause: Subject to clauses 9, 15.1 and 15.4, the Supplier's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed one hundred and fifty per cent (150%) of the Contract Value.
entries.why_it_matters: The cap is above AtliQ's normal 1x fees and carves out uncapped indemnities that group companies can enforce directly, so the Brightwater group can cite it as an accepted position.

entries.scope: All IP in the Deliverables (software, data models, reports, documentation) is assigned to the Customer on creation, and AtliQ's pre-existing materials incorporated in them are licensed perpetually to the whole Brightwater Group.
entries.counterparty: Brightwater Insurance Inc. and Brightwater Group
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual
entries.quoted_clause: All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall vest in the Customer on creation. The Supplier hereby assigns all such rights to the Customer with full title guarantee.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse the claims data mart models or dashboards built here for other insurance clients, and any reusable accelerators embedded in them are irrevocably licensed group-wide.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not subcontract any part of the Services, including to freelancers or other AtliQ entities, without the Customer's prior written consent.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the 18-month term (depends on term)
entries.quoted_clause: The Supplier shall not assign or subcontract without the Customer's prior written consent.
entries.why_it_matters: Using an offshore AtliQ affiliate or contractors requires written consent, and any approved personnel must also pass Brightwater Group background screening.

entries.scope: Customer Data may not be processed outside the United States without prior written consent; GLBA, Connecticut Data Privacy Act and Brightwater security requirements apply, with 24-hour incident notice.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the 18-month term (depends on term); confidentiality survives indefinitely
entries.quoted_clause: The Supplier shall not process Customer Data outside the United States without the Customer's prior written consent.
entries.why_it_matters: This bars offshore delivery teams from touching claims and policy data unless consent is obtained, and the obligation must flow down to any approved subcontractor.

entries.scope: Al Noor consents to AtliQ providing demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC only under the February 2026 Seaside SOW, and any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on SOW needs fresh written consent.
entries.expiry_or_term: Limited to the Seaside SOW dated February 2026; lapses with that SOW. Any further Seaside work needs a new consent while Clause 12 of the MSA remains in force.
entries.quoted_clause: This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client;
entries.clause_ref: Waiver letter ANHG/LGL/2026/031, paras 2–3(a) (under MSA Clause 12.4)
entries.why_it_matters: Any upsell, renewal or change order with Seaside must be cleared with Al Noor first, or AtliQ will breach the MSA.

entries.scope: AtliQ reaffirms that the MSA Clause 12 restriction still applies to every other Hospitality Business in Oman and the wider GCC, and the consent does not cover any AtliQ Affiliate.
entries.region: Sultanate of Oman and the GCC
entries.expiry_or_term: Per Clause 12 of the MSA dated 15 March 2025; the duration depends on the MSA term and is not stated in this letter.
entries.quoted_clause: It does not extend to ... (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier. ... Save as expressly set out in paragraph 2 above, all other terms of Clause 12 remain in full force and effect
entries.clause_ref: Waiver letter ANHG/LGL/2026/031, paras 3(b), 3(c) and 5; MSA Clause 12
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ has countersigned a reaffirmation of a GCC hospitality non-compete, which blocks other GCC hotel clients without consent. The carve-out for Affiliates suggests Clause 12 reaches AtliQ group companies, so the MSA text should be checked.

entries.scope: AtliQ must ring-fence staff: anyone who has accessed Al Noor Client Data cannot access Seaside data without Al Noor's prior written approval, and Al Noor Confidential Information must not be used for Seaside.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the duration of the Seaside SOW.
entries.quoted_clause: the Supplier shall not use or disclose any Confidential Information of the Client, and shall ensure that personnel who have had access to Client Data under the Agreement do not have access to Seaside data save with the Client's prior written approval.
entries.why_it_matters: This is a staffing ethical-wall constraint that must be built into the Seaside team and access controls, and into any subcontractor or freelancer staffing.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not solicit, employ or engage any Meridian employee or consultant it had contact with in connection with the Purpose, without Meridian's prior written consent.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of the Agreement (3 years from 16 July 2026) plus 24 months thereafter, i.e. until about 16 July 2031; runs longer if the Agreement ends early only to the extent the term is shortened
entries.quoted_clause: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months thereafter, the Recipient shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or engagement, or employ or engage, any employee or consultant of Meridian with whom the Recipient had contact in connection with the Purpose, without Meridian's prior written consent.
entries.why_it_matters: This is a hard no-hire, not just a non-solicit, buried in an NDA, and it blocks AtliQ from hiring or contracting Meridian staff or consultants for roughly five years, even if they approach AtliQ themselves.

entries.scope: Meridian Confidential Information may be disclosed only to AtliQ's own employees bound by written confidentiality, so freelancers, contractors, subcontractors and affiliates cannot be given access.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of 3 years from 16 July 2026, with obligations surviving 3 years after expiry or termination (up to about 16 July 2032)
entries.quoted_clause: disclose it only to its employees who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by written confidentiality obligations;
entries.why_it_matters: Any staffing of the Meridian evaluation or a follow-on engagement with freelancers or subcontractors would breach the NDA unless Meridian first consents in writing or the clause is amended.

entries.scope: AtliQ must comply with the DPDP Act 2023 for Meridian patient and health data and must notify Meridian of any unauthorised access or disclosure within 24 hours.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of 3 years from 16 July 2026, with obligations surviving 3 years after expiry or termination
entries.quoted_clause: comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 in relation to any personal data, including health data, forming part of the Confidential Information; and (e) notify Meridian within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of any unauthorised access or disclosure.
entries.why_it_matters: The 24-hour breach-notification window for health data is tight and sets a precedent, and AtliQ's incident processes (and any later subcontractors) must be able to meet it.

entries.scope: AtliQ gives Meridian an uncapped indemnity for all losses arising from any breach by AtliQ or its personnel.
entries.expiry_or_term: Term of 3 years from 16 July 2026, with obligations surviving 3 years after expiry or termination
entries.quoted_clause: The Recipient shall indemnify Meridian against losses arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or its personnel.
entries.why_it_matters: There is no cap or exclusion of indirect loss, so a breach involving patient health data could expose AtliQ to unlimited liability, well beyond its normal 1x fees position.

entries.scope: IP in Deliverables built specifically for Trustline (collections data mart, early-warning scorecard, Power BI dashboards) vests in the Company on full payment, while AtliQ keeps pre-existing IP under a perpetual non-exclusive licence to the Company.
entries.expiry_or_term: Perpetual
entries.quoted_clause: Upon full payment, intellectual property in the Deliverables developed specifically for the Company shall vest in the Company. The Service Provider retains its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the Company a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use it as incorporated in the Deliverables.
entries.why_it_matters: AtliQ cannot reuse the bespoke collections scorecard or dashboards for other lenders, so reusable components must be clearly documented as pre-existing IP, and freelancer contracts must assign IP to AtliQ so it can pass it on.

entries.scope: AtliQ may not subcontract any part of the Services (or assign the Agreement) without Trustline's prior written consent.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the term of the Agreement (one year from 15 August 2026 unless extended or terminated earlier)
entries.quoted_clause: Neither Party shall assign or subcontract this Agreement without prior written consent of the other.
entries.why_it_matters: Any freelancer, offshore partner or other AtliQ group entity used on this work needs Trustline's written consent first, which restricts AtliQ's staffing model.

entries.scope: Company Data must be processed in line with DPDP Act 2023, the IT Act and RBI directions, stored only in India, and security incidents must be reported within six hours.
entries.expiry_or_term: For as long as AtliQ processes Company Data (Agreement term of one year from 15 August 2026, unless extended)
entries.quoted_clause: The Service Provider shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable RBI directions in processing Company Data, and shall store Company Data only in India. The Service Provider shall report any security incident to the Company within six (6) hours of detection.
entries.why_it_matters: India-only storage and a six-hour incident-reporting window must flow down to any subcontractor or cloud vendor, which rules out offshore freelancers or non-India hosting for this data.

entries.scope: Trustline, its auditors and the Reserve Bank of India may inspect and audit AtliQ's records and facilities relating to the Services.
entries.expiry_or_term: For the term of the Agreement (one year from 15 August 2026 unless extended); no express survival
entries.quoted_clause: The Company, its auditors and the Reserve Bank of India shall have the right to inspect and audit the Service Provider's records and facilities relating to the Services.
entries.why_it_matters: RBI outsourcing-style audit rights extend to AtliQ's facilities and must be mirrored in any approved subcontractor agreements, setting a precedent for other regulated BFSI clients.
